'''KSEG''' is a free ([[GNU General Public License|GPL]]) [[interactive geometry software]] for exploring [[Euclidean geometry]]. It was created by Ilya Baran.<ref>{{cite web |title=Software Search - zbMATH Open |url=https://zbmath.org/software/5361 |website=zbmath.org}}</ref>
It runs on [[Unix]]-based platforms. It also compiles and runs on [[Mac OS X]] and should run on anything that [[Qt (framework)|Qt]] supports. Additionally, it was also ported to [[Microsoft Windows]].

KSEG is a tool designed to let you easily visualize dynamic properties of [[compass and straightedge]] construction and to make geometric exploration as fast and easy as possible. KSEG was inspired by [[the Geometer's Sketchpad]], but it goes beyond the functionality that Sketchpad provides.
KSEG can be used in the classroom, for personal exploration of geometry, or for making high-quality figures for [[LaTeX]].<ref>{{cite web |title=KSEG Help |url=http://new.math.uiuc.edu/netgeom/advice/kseg_help_en.html |website=new.math.uiuc.edu}}</ref>
